rationale: Re-freeze review (2026-10-20, fresh independent Opus review against the current generation; decision content verified byte-identical to the previously reviewed decision apart from the evidence pin). Held EO 9380 (8 FR 13081) establishes the Foreign Economic Administration; every operative paragraph runs through the FEA or its Administrator. Held EO 9630 Part I para. 1: 'The Foreign Economic Administration established by Executive Order No. 9380 ... and the office of the Administrator ... are terminated', with functions transferred to State, RFC, Commerce and Agriculture; para. 12 keeps prior regulations relating to transferred functions, not EO 9380 as an operating order. My status NO (ending by termination of the entity, not by name-revocation; noted). D6: EO 9385 is an earlier amendment; EO 10945 sec. 5(a) later supersedes 'provisions relating to export control ... contained in [EO 9380, 9630] and are now effective' (a sweep clause, consistent with the end; it revives nothing). No held later order restores the FEA. Accept.
